# CheckATS

> CheckATS is a free, independent ATS resume preparation tool at https://checkats.online/. Compare pasted resume text or a text-based PDF with a job description, then request optional AI feedback or a rewrite. No account required.

## Main pages

- [Resume checker](https://checkats.online/): local keyword matching and extracted-text checks.
- [Scoring method and data handling](https://checkats.online/methodology/): current formula, rules, limits, worked example, and external processing.
- [Resume guides](https://checkats.online/guide/): published resume resources.
- [Software engineer checklist](https://checkats.online/guide/ats-resume-checklist-software-engineers/): practical advice with product limitations and a vendor source.

## Facts and limits

- The simulated score is 60% selected JD exact-keyword coverage plus 40% extracted-text checks; it is not an employer ATS score or a hiring probability.
- A skills dictionary selects JD terms; statistical extraction supplements thin matches or acts as a fallback. Matching ignores case but does not expand synonyms or acronyms.
- The four text checks test email presence, supported date formats, clean characters, and 300–3,000 non-whitespace characters. They do not inspect the original document layout or recognize every valid date format.
- Text-based PDF import runs locally; scanned PDFs need OCR, which is not included. DOCX upload is not supported.
- Optional AI review assesses writing, results, specificity, and role alignment separately from the local score. AI outputs may vary and can be inaccurate.
- Standard AI allowances are 5 review requests and 2 rewrite requests per IP per UTC day. Automatic review refreshes also consume requests; shared networks share allowances.
- Local checks do not upload the resume. Optional AI review and rewrite send it to external providers; email delivery uses Resend. See the methodology page for data handling.
- CheckATS is not affiliated with Greenhouse, Workday, or other ATS vendors. Their features and employer configurations differ.
